name: `gh pr merge` matches inside `gh pr merged`
expect: ⛔ `gh pr merged` is not `gh pr merge`

name: any file whose name ends in goal-threads.md rebuilds the goal tree
expect: ⛔ another file named goal-threads.md elsewhere does not

name: every generator gets the default timeout instead of the one asked for
expect: each generator gets its OWN timeout

name: a failed generator makes the HOOK exit non-zero
edits: if a.all and any(r["rc"] != 0 for r in results):
if any(r["rc"] != 0 for r in results):
expect: ⛔ --hook exits 0 even when every generator failed, and the report reaches stdout

name: a hook that cannot run at all exits non-zero
expect: ⛔ --hook that cannot run at all still exits 0, and SAYS the pages may be stale

name: a generator that crashed (negative exit) is not named as stale
edits: bad = [r for r in results if r["rc"] != 0]
bad = [r for r in results if r["rc"] > 0]
expect: ⛔ every failure is NAMED with its exit code, and says the page is stale

name: --all exits 0 when a page did not rebuild
edits:
if a.all and any(r["rc"] != 0 for r in results):
            return 1

if a.all and any(r["rc"] != 0 for r in results):
            return 0
expect: --all exits 1 when a page did not rebuild (it is a command, not a hook)

name: an unrelated command still prints a rebuild report
expect: --hook on an unrelated command is silent and launches nothing
